brand.name: DLF Limited
brand.tagline: Your gateway to luxury living across India

never_state: guaranteed speculative appreciation or unverified resale numbers
non-RERA registered specifications or unapproved possession dates
unauthorized spot cash discounts without VP confirmation
informal booking transfers outside official DLF escrow accounts

never_state_notes.guaranteed speculative appreciation: Property valuations reflect prevailing market trends and historical performance. We provide official historical capital appreciation rates rather than speculative projections.
